'''April 2000 Glenside tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania on 2 April 2000. [[John Lolli]] won it. It is known from Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d451">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-glenside-pa-4-2d451/ glenside-pa-4-2], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 3 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-glenside-pa-4-2d451/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 April 2000
* '''Site:''' RPG Outpost, Glenside, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[John Lolli]]
